newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures mixed on sterling, EU tender.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures mixed on sterling, EU tender.

text.p: LIFFE grain futures ended mixed, with the helpful effect of a weak sterling offset by disappointment at the EU's lackluster export tender award.
There had been a minor rally early in the day on country buying, but the effect wore off, one trader said.
He was pleased with the level of activity. Wheat volume totalled 543 lots, with March, which traded 184 lots, the most active.
March last traded 0.05 stg down at 93.70 stg.
The main feature in barley was against actuals trade done by shippers and country merchants, the trader said.
Barley activity was concentrated on March, which traded 70 lots out of a total of 79. It last traded unchanged at 93.30 stg.
